## Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Separately, satellite data show that bleaching-level heat stress affected roughly 84.4% of global reef area between January 2023 and September 2025.

That measured footprint exceeds the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

The record refers to the area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress. It does not mean that every exposed reef was verified to have bleached or died.
